description: How often a target like this one has been chased down in men's T20: the rate for targets within 10 runs of yours, with the number of chases and a 95% interval, from 4,502 chases through 17 Sep 2026. Optional ground record. Per call.

target.description: The target to be chased (first-innings total + 1).

venue.description: The ground's name, for that ground's own chase record.
